# spyro

SSH tunneling and remote-command CLI driven by a project `spyro.toml` of profiles (`staging`, `production`, ...). Remote commands select a profile with `-p <profile>`; local ones (`profiles`, `status`, `install`, ...) need none.

## Rules every agent must follow

1. **Read before acting.** Run `spyro profiles` (local, safe) to learn each profile's host, user and
   `remote_path`. Never guess remote paths; never assume `-C`/`remote_path` when `profiles` shows `(default)`.
2. **Name the profile on remote commands** with `-p <name>` (`up`/`down`/`logs supervisor` take it as an
   argument; `artisan`/`ssh`/`ps` fall back to `[defaults].profile` or the sole profile). Local commands
   (`profiles`, `status`, `init`, `install`, `update`, `pins`, `config`, `auth`) need no profile; `profiles -p`
   is an optional output filter. Avoid `--all`,
   bare `up`/`down`, and `doctor`: they touch every profile in `spyro.toml`, including production. Never run
   anything against a production profile unless the user explicitly asked for that profile in this conversation.
3. **Secrets stay on the server.** Never print `.env` contents, `env pull` output, passwords or tokens.
   `env diff` is masked for this reason. Passwords come from the OS keychain or `SPYRO_PASSWORD[_<PROFILE>]`.
4. **Pick the right executor:** shell/Python/Docker → `spyro run` (`-C` for the app dir); Laravel expression
   → `spyro eval`; Artisan → `spyro artisan`; local PHP file → `spyro script`; interactive → `spyro ssh`/`tinker`.
5. **Exit codes are real.** A failing remote command fails spyro; check it instead of parsing output.
6. **`sudo` is never added for you** by `run`; app commands (`artisan`, `eval`, `script`, `wp`, `tinker`)
   escalate only on `sudo = true` profiles (`--no-escalate` disables).

## Commands

| Command | Purpose | Skill |
|---|---|---|
| `spyro apache` | Manage Apache web server on remote server | `spyro-apache` |
| `spyro artisan` | Run Laravel Artisan commands on the remote host | `spyro-artisan` |
| `spyro auth` | Manage stored credentials (macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service) | `spyro-auth` |
| `spyro caddy` | Manage Caddy web server on remote server | `spyro-caddy` |
| `spyro config` | Manage spyro configuration | `spyro-config` |
| `spyro cp` | Securely copy files with auto-sudo escalation | `spyro-cp` |
| `spyro db` | Database commands (MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL) | `spyro-db` |
| `spyro doctor` | Run automated diagnostics | `spyro-doctor` |
| `spyro down` | Stop tunnels for a profile (or all if omitted) | `spyro-down` |
| `spyro env` | Manage remote environment files | `spyro-env` |
| `spyro eval` | Evaluate a PHP expression on the remote Laravel server (PHP only) | `spyro-eval` |
| `spyro init` | Bootstrap configuration and run toolchain audit | `spyro-init` |
| `spyro install` | Install spyro add-ons on this machine (currently: AI agent skills) | `spyro-install` |
| `spyro logs` | View remote logs (Laravel, Nginx, Apache, PHP-FPM) | `spyro-logs` |
| `spyro nginx` | Manage Nginx web server on remote server | `spyro-nginx` |
| `spyro php` | Manage PHP on remote server | `spyro-php` |
| `spyro pin` | Pin a local directory for automatic sync to remote server | `spyro-pin` |
| `spyro pins` | List all pinned sync directories | `spyro-pins` |
| `spyro profiles` | Show every profile as spyro resolves it (spyro.toml plus ~/.ssh/config) | `spyro-profiles` |
| `spyro ps` | List processes on remote server | `spyro-ps` |
| `spyro redis` | Run Redis commands on remote server | `spyro-redis` |
| `spyro run` | Execute a shell command on remote server(s) | `spyro-run` |
| `spyro script` | Upload a PHP file and run it with plain ``php`` on the remote server | `spyro-script` |
| `spyro ssh` | Open an interactive shell on a profile's server | `spyro-ssh` |
| `spyro status` | Display health, active tunnels, and port mappings | `spyro-status` |
| `spyro supervisor` | Manage Supervisor processes on remote server | `spyro-supervisor` |
| `spyro sync` | Watch pinned directories and auto-sync to remote server | `spyro-sync` |
| `spyro tinker` | Run Laravel Tinker interactively or with --eval/--file | `spyro-tinker` |
| `spyro unpin` | Remove a pinned sync directory | `spyro-unpin` |
| `spyro up` | Start tunnels for a profile (or every profile with forwarded_ports) | `spyro-up` |
| `spyro update` | Self-update spyro to the latest version from GitHub | `spyro-update` |
| `spyro wp` | Run WP-CLI commands on the remote host | `spyro-wp` |

Each command has its own skill with the full `--help` output and gotchas.
